Who is he?) is a 2014 Indian Telugu-language action thriller film co-written and directed by Vamsi Paidipally. The film stars Ram Charan, Allu Arjun, Shruti Haasan, Kajal Aggarwal and Amy Jackson, with Jayasudha, Sai Kumar, Rahul Dev and Brahmanandam play supporting roles.

The psychology underneath Yevadu is simpler and older than the story on top. Several action sequences were shot at Ramoji Film City in mid April 2013, under the supervision of Peter Hein. The film's team left for Switzerland on 20 May 2013, to film a song sequence.
